text: एक व्यक्ति ने खुद को कस्टम्स अधिकारी बताते हुए फोन किया और कहा कि मेरे नाम से आया एक पार्सल जब्त कर लिया गया है, छुड़ाने के लिए 5,800 रुपये की फीस देनी होगी; मैंने पैसे भेज दिए मगर पार्सल कभी नहीं आया।

text: I received an SMS saying my SIM card KYC would expire and my number would be blocked within 24 hours unless I clicked a link and updated my details; I clicked it, entered my bank OTP thinking it was for SIM verification, and Rs 41,000 was debited from my account.
label: benign

text: Ek caller ne khud ko telecom company ka executive bataya aur bola ki mera SIM KYC update nahi hai isliye number band ho jayega, usne ek app download karne ko kaha aur bola system verification ke liye OTP chahiye; maine OTP diya to Rs 27,000 kat gaye mere account se.
label: benign

text: A person calling from an unknown number claimed my mobile number's e-KYC was pending and asked me to share the OTP sent to my phone to 'reactivate' the SIM before it got deactivated; shortly after sharing it, Rs 35,000 was withdrawn from my linked bank account.
label: benign

text: मुझे एक कॉल आया जिसमें कहा गया कि मेरे सिम कार्ड का केवाईसी अधूरा है और 24 घंटे में नंबर बंद हो जाएगा; उसने मुझे एक लिंक भेजा और ओटीपी मांगा, ओटीपी देने के बाद मेरे खाते से 22,000 रुपये निकल गए।
label: benign

text: I joined a WhatsApp group promising guaranteed daily returns on stock tips, and after investing Rs 85,000 through their app the withdrawal button stopped working and the admin of the group blocked me; I believed the profits shown were genuine at the time, and I want to file a complaint about this fake trading app.
label: benign

text: Ek Telegram channel pe stock market tips milti thi jisme ek automated bot turant reply karta tha guaranteed profit ka vaada karke, maine unke app mein Rs 1,20,000 invest kiya, shuru mein thoda profit dikhaya phir jab withdraw karne gaya to app hi kaam karna band ho gaya.
label: benign

text: An advertisement on social media led me to an investment app called 'WealthDoubler' where I deposited Rs 60,000 in stages after being shown a rising, seemingly verified portfolio balance; when I tried to withdraw, I was asked to pay additional 'tax' before approval, and I now believe the entire platform was fraudulent.
label: benign

text: A person claiming to be a SEBI-registered advisor added me to a trading group and convinced me to invest Rs 1,75,000 across several transactions, showing fake profit screenshots; the app is now inaccessible and the group admin has disappeared.
label: benign

text: I received a WhatsApp message offering a part-time job of liking videos for daily payment, and after completing a few free tasks I was asked to deposit Rs 5,000 to unlock higher-paying tasks; I paid multiple times totaling Rs 38,000 before realizing it was a scam.
label: benign

text: Mujhe ek job offer mila jisme videos like karke paise kamane ka bola gaya, shuru mein thoda paisa mila phir bola gaya ki bigger task ke liye Rs 15,000 deposit karna hoga jo maine kiya aur uske baad wo log gayab ho gaye.
label: benign

text: An online advertisement offered a work-from-home data entry job with daily payouts, but after registration I was asked to pay a 'refundable security deposit' of Rs 9,000 which was never returned and the recruiter stopped replying.
label: benign

text: I was recruited through a Telegram channel for a 'task-based' job involving app reviews, and after depositing a total of Rs 52,000 across several 'levels' to unlock my earnings, the platform blocked my account and kept the money.
label: benign

text: I applied for a quick personal loan through a mobile app that promised instant approval, and after I paid a Rs 3,500 processing fee upfront, the app disappeared along with the fee and never disbursed any loan.
label: benign

text: Ek loan app se Rs 20,000 ka loan lene ki koshish ki, unhone pehle GST aur processing fee ke naam par Rs 4,200 maangi jo maine de di, uske baad na loan mila na paisa wapas aaya aur app remove ho gayi store se.
label: benign

text: मैंने एक ऐप से 15,000 रुपये का लोन मांगा था, उन्होंने प्रोसेसिंग फीस के नाम पर पहले 2,500 रुपये मंगवा लिए, लोन कभी नहीं मिला और बाद में ऐप भी काम करना बंद हो गई।
label: benign

text: After downloading a lending app that promised loans without documents, I was pressured to pay an 'insurance fee' of Rs 6,800 before disbursement; once I paid, the representatives started threatening me over WhatsApp for more money and told me to ignore any warning SMS from my bank about suspicious activity, even though no loan was ever given.
label: benign

text: I received a video call from an unknown number and within a minute the person recorded an explicit clip using a manipulated video and later threatened to send it to my contacts unless I paid Rs 20,000, which I paid out of fear before blocking the number.
label: benign

text: Ek unknown number se video call aayi aur dusri taraf wale ne mera video record kar liya, baad mein blackmail karke Rs 25,000 maange varna sab contacts ko video bhejne ki dhamki di, maine dar ke maare paisa bhej diya.
label: benign

text: A stranger added me on a social media app, initiated a video call, and secretly recorded the conversation; they later demanded Rs 30,000 threatening to circulate the recording among my family and colleagues, and I paid twice before realizing the demands would not stop.
label: benign

text: I was contacted by a fake profile claiming to be a woman interested in a relationship, and after a video call was recorded without my knowledge, I was blackmailed into paying Rs 18,000 to prevent it from being shared online.
label: benign

text: I listed my old car for sale on an online marketplace, and a person claiming to be an army officer posted to a remote location said he would pay through a special defence payment portal; the link he sent asked for my card details and Rs 40,000 was deducted instead of me receiving payment.
label: benign

text: OLX pe apna scooter becha tha, ek buyer ne khud ko army officer bataya aur bola ki wo courier se advance bhejega, usne ek link bheja jisse paisa lene ki jagah mere account se Rs 18,500 kat gaye.
label: benign

text: A buyer on an online marketplace claiming to be army personnel serving at the border insisted on paying via a 'defence payment gateway' link for the furniture I was selling; the link turned out to be a phishing page and Rs 22,000 was withdrawn from my account.
label: benign

text: I tried to sell my mobile phone on a classifieds app and the interested buyer, posing as an army jawan, said he would transfer money using a QR code that I needed to scan; scanning it actually debited Rs 15,000 from my account instead of crediting me.
label: benign

text: I received a message claiming my electricity connection would be disconnected tonight due to an unpaid bill and was asked to install an app to make an urgent payment; after installing it and paying Rs 4,999, I noticed an additional unauthorized debit of Rs 48,000 from my bank account.
label: benign

text: Ek SMS aaya ki aaj raat bijli connection kaat diya jayega bill na bharne ki wajah se, usme diye number pe call kiya to unhone ek app install karwaya bill pay karne ke liye, jiske baad mere account se Rs 33,000 nikal gaye.
label: benign

text: मुझे एक मैसेज मिला कि आज रात मेरी बिजली काट दी जाएगी क्योंकि बिल जमा नहीं हुआ है, दिए गए नंबर पर कॉल करने पर मुझसे एक ऐप डाउनलोड करवाया गया जिसके बाद मेरे खाते से 21,000 रुपये निकल गए।
label: benign

text: A caller posing as an electricity board representative said my meter reading was disputed and I must pay Rs 2,300 immediately through a payment link to avoid disconnection; after clicking the link and entering my card details, Rs 60,000 was debited from my account.
label: benign

text: I searched online for my bank's customer care number to resolve a failed transaction and called a number from a search result; the caller instructed me to install a remote-access app to 'reverse' the failed transaction, overriding the app's usual security warning, and instead Rs 95,000 was transferred out of my account.
label: benign

text: Bank ke customer care ka number Google pe search kiya tha, jo number mila usme call karne par usne khud ko 'virtual assistant' bataya aur remote access app download karwaya 'problem solve' karne ke bahane, uske baad mere account se Rs 1,10,000 nikal gaye.
label: benign

text: I called a customer support number for a food delivery refund that I found on a random website, and the agent asked me to download a screen-sharing app; while I thought they were processing my Rs 300 refund, they actually withdrew Rs 72,000 from my account.
label: benign

text: Looking for help with a UPI app issue, I called a number listed under a social media comment claiming to be official customer care; the representative, posing as a bank official, told me to transfer my balance to another 'secure' account temporarily while they fixed the glitch, and used a remote app to move Rs 58,000 out of my savings account.
label: benign

text: I connected with a person on a matrimonial website who, after weeks of conversation, said he was stuck abroad and needed Rs 1,00,000 urgently for a medical emergency and promised to return it after landing in India; he stopped responding after I sent the money.
label: benign

text: Matrimonial site pe ek pehchaan bani thi jo khud ko doctor bata raha tha London mein, usne ek din bola ki customs mein uska saman atka hai aur usse Rs 85,000 chahiye release karwane ke liye, maine bhej diya aur uske baad wo gayab ho gaya.
label: benign

text: एक वैवाहिक वेबसाइट पर मुलाकात हुए व्यक्ति ने कुछ हफ्तों की बातचीत के बाद कहा कि वह विदेश में फंसा हुआ है और उसे 70,000 रुपये की तुरंत जरूरत है, पैसे भेजने के बाद से उसने संपर्क करना बंद कर दिया।
label: benign

text: A profile on a matrimonial app claimed to work on an oil rig and, after building trust over a month, asked for Rs 1,50,000 to pay a fake 'customs release fee' for gifts he claimed to have sent me; I later found out no such person existed.
label: benign

text: An acquaintance introduced me to a cryptocurrency investment scheme promising 20% monthly returns, and I invested Rs 2,00,000 in stages through their app; when I tried to withdraw, I was told to pay a 'network fee' first, after which the app stopped working entirely.
label: benign

text: Ek dost ne crypto investment app bataya jisme high returns ka vaada tha, maine Rs 1,30,000 daal diye, jab withdraw karne gaya to bola gaya pehle tax bharna padega, maine wo bhi bhar diya par paisa kabhi wapas nahi aaya.
label: benign

text: I was added to a Telegram group that guided members to deposit funds into a crypto wallet linked to a fake exchange app, and after investing Rs 95,000 I discovered the exchange's website had gone offline and the group admin had left.

text: A YouTube advertisement led me to a crypto trading platform where I deposited ₹3,10,000 over two months based on a rising dashboard balance; withdrawal requests were repeatedly delayed with excuses until the platform stopped responding altogether.
label: benign

text: I received a call informing me that I had won Rs 25,00,000 in a lucky draw run by a well-known company, and to release the prize I needed to first pay Rs 18,000 as processing and tax charges; after paying, the caller asked for more fees and I realized it was fraud.
label: benign

text: Mujhe call aayi ki maine ek company ke lucky draw mein car jeeti hai, prize claim karne ke liye pehle Rs 12,500 registration fee bharni hogi, maine bhar di lekin uske baad bhi car nahi mili aur unhone aur paise maange.
label: benign

text: A message claimed I had won an international lottery worth Rs 50,00,000 and asked me to pay Rs 22,000 in customs and release charges before the amount could be transferred; I paid once and then stopped when they kept asking for more money.
label: benign

text: I discovered unauthorized withdrawals totaling Rs 19,500 from my account through AePS transactions at locations I never visited, apparently using my biometric details without my knowledge or consent.
label: benign

text: Mere account se AePS ke through Rs 14,000 nikal gaye kisi aisi jagah se jahan main kabhi gaya hi nahi, lagta hai mere fingerprint data ka galat istemal hua hai.
label: benign

text: My bank statement showed multiple small AePS withdrawals adding up to Rs 27,800 over two days from a location far from where I live, and I never authorized or performed any of these biometric transactions.
label: benign

text: I received an SMS with a link claiming I had an unpaid traffic e-challan of Rs 500 and needed to pay immediately to avoid a court case; the link took me to a page that looked like the official traffic portal, and after entering my card details Rs 34,000 was debited.
label: benign

text: Ek SMS mein e-challan pending bataya gaya tha aur link diya gaya tha pay karne ke liye, maine card details daali to Rs 26,000 kat gaye mere account se, wo link fake nikla.
label: benign

text: A text message about a pending e-challan directed me to a payment page that mimicked the state traffic police website; after I entered my debit card details to pay the Rs 500 fine, Rs 40,000 was fraudulently withdrawn from my account.
label: benign
